convention: daily returns from SPY total-return levels on the portfolio calendar (one preceding value anchor + every return session, factor_returns_on contract)
notes: gaps or missing endpoint fail hard - never intersected or filled

convention: BIL adjusted total return (SPDR 1-3M T-Bill ETF) is the cash benchmark
notes: tear-sheet column cash_benchmark_id = BIL@provisional_market_total_return_fx_2026-06-30_v1; manifest enforces cash_symbol = BIL

convention: mean(daily excess over BIL) / std(ddof=1) * sqrt(252)
data_source: computed from equity curves + cash series

convention: MAR = 0 on the BIL-excess stream (equivalently MAR = cash rate). downside RMS = sqrt(mean(min(excess. 0)^2)); Sortino = mean/RMS * sqrt(252)
data_source: computed from equity curves + cash series
notes: downside RMS (daily) is also reported as its own row

convention: OLS of RAW portfolio daily returns on RAW SPY daily returns with intercept. alpha(ann) = intercept * 252. HAC (Newey-West) maxlags = 5
notes: produces beta / alpha / t(alpha) HAC / R2 in the tear sheets; raw returns - NOT excess returns

term: basket regression (R2 own 4-ETF basket / idio vol vs basket)
convention: OLS of portfolio daily returns on the own 4-ETF daily local-quote returns with intercept. HAC maxlags = 5. idio vol = residual std(ddof=1) * sqrt(252)
residuals of the raw_market_model regression. sigma_e = resid std(ddof=1) * sqrt(252). appraisal = alpha(ann) / sigma_e

term: active return / tracking error / information ratio
convention: active = portfolio minus SPY on the shared daily calendar. active(ann) = mean * 252. TE = std(ddof=1) * sqrt(252). IR = active/TE
rolling Sharpe window = 252 on the BIL-excess stream. moving-block bootstrap n_boot = 1000. block length = 1. alpha = 0.05. seed = 0. HAC sigma with automatic bandwidth L
data_source: computed from equity curves + cash series
notes: settings are disclosed per row in the ssr_* columns of the canonical tear sheets

convention: 252 trading days for every annualization and HAC scaling
strategy equity curves are legacy_mixed_local_quotes (SWDA.L in GBX local quote). SPY and BIL are USD total return
notes: USD weekly Markowitz frontier is a separate asset-only basis
